poam-items.description: No software in this repo can satisfy Tier-3 OS requirements: port to a separation microkernel (seL4, proofs complete on AArch64 Aug 2026) with accredited hardware, TEMPEST-shielded enclosures, and Type-1 cryptography. Multi-year program outside this codebase.
